items.quote: Single phase, as well as two phases samples, of the magnesium borides were prepared by direct synthesis from the elements (Mg with 99.999 wt% purity and B, 325-mesh crystalline powder, with 99.7 wt% purity), into outgassed Ta crucibles sealed by welding under a pure Ar flow.
items.starting_materials: Mg with 99.999 wt% purity and B, 325-mesh crystalline powder, with 99.7 wt% purity

items.quote: While for preparing the compound MgB2 the method patented by some of the authors [7] was adopted, the synthesis of the B-richer borides was carried out by slow heating of the Ta crucible, under vacuum in a high-frequency induction furnace, up to high temperatures (indicatively: up to 1550 8C over 4 h, up to 1650 8C over 6 h and up to 1900 8C over 8 h, respectively, for MgB4, MgB7 and MgB20).
